lessons.title: 1. Defining Classes & Constructors
lessons.description: C++ classes encapsulate member variables and functions. Member initialization lists are preferred in constructors. Create a `Player` class.
learning_objectives: Define C++ class with constructor and getter member functions

lessons.title: 2. Mutator Member Functions
lessons.description: Add a `take_damage(int damage)` method to modify `health_` safely.
learning_objectives: Implement member functions that modify object state

lessons.title: 3. Bank Account Ledger (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Encapsulate account balance and transaction operations in C++.
learning_objectives: Implement BankAccount class with deposit and withdraw methods

tests.name: test_bank_account
tests.test_code: BankAccount acc("Alice", 100.0); acc.deposit(50.0); assert(acc.get_balance() == 150.0); assert(acc.withdraw(30.0) == true); assert(acc.get_balance() == 120.0);

lessons.title: 4. Rectangle Class (Practice)
lessons.description: Calculate area and perimeter in a Rectangle class.
learning_objectives: Compute geometric values in C++ member functions

lessons.title: 5. Unit 6 Checkpoint: C++ Classes Mastery
